description: Dazzle the room in this Suvidha Couture floor-length gown. Features intricate hand-embroidered sequin and bead accents, structured corsetry styling, and a cascading flared skirt for gala events and grand receptions.

name: Aura Studio Elegant Floral A-Line Tiered Midi Western Dress
title: Floral Tiered Midi Western Dress
description: Flow into sun-drenched weekends with this enchanting floral tiered midi dress. Designed with a cinched waist, fluttering sleeves, and a tiered flared hem, it's an irresistible warm-weather wardrobe essential.

name: DENNISON Women Solid Slim Fit Single-Breasted 2-Piece Formal Trouser Suit
title: DENNISON 2-Piece Formal Trouser Suit
description: Command attention in professional meetings and corporate events with the DENNISON women's single-breasted power suit. Precision-tailored with structured shoulders, notch lapels, and tapered formal trousers for an authoritative yet feminine look.

name: Trendia Royal Embroidered Flared Anarkali Kurta Set with Dupatta
title: Trendia Flared Anarkali Kurta Set
description: Step into regal glamour with the Trendia Embroidered Anarkali Set. Featuring a wide-flared silhouette, ornate yoke zari work, coordinated churidar/pants, and an ethereal sheer dupatta, it's tailored for festivities and weddings.

name: Breeze Studio Printed Resort Relaxed-Fit 2-Piece Co-ord Set
title: Printed Relaxed-Fit Co-ord Set
description: Keep it casual and cozy with this modern printed two-piece co-ord set. Features an airy silhouette, lightweight feel, and vibrant detailing that will keep you cool and stylish throughout the day.

name: Urban Chic Floral Print Notch Collar Blazer & Trouser Co-ord Set
title: Floral Blazer & Trouser Co-ord Set
description: Take the guesswork out of styling with this matching two-piece floral co-ord set. Comprising a relaxed notch collar shirt top and tailored ankle-length trousers, it transitions seamlessly from boardroom brunch to vacation getaways.

name: Designer Embroidered Sweetheart Neck Padded Silk Blouse
title: Sweetheart Neck Embroidered Silk Blouse
description: Pair your favorite sarees and lehengas with this impeccably tailored sweetheart neck padded silk blouse. Features rich thread embroidery, elbow-length sleeves, and high-quality internal padding for seamless comfort.

name: Sougat Paul Designer Georgette Embellished Pre-Draped Saree
title: Sougat Paul Designer Georgette Saree
description: Make a high-fashion statement at evening galas and wedding receptions with this Sougat Paul designer georgette saree. Adorned with delicate embellishments and a fluid drape, it radiates red-carpet sophistication.

name: Apella Neelima Blue Cotton Chikankari Embroidered Kurti
title: Apella Blue Cotton Chikankari Kurti
description: Experience the timeless artistry of Lucknowi Chikankari with the Apella Neelima Blue Kurti. Detailed with handcrafted thread work along the neckline and hem, this serene blue kurti is an exquisite blend of heritage charm and modern comfort.

name: Cotton Culture Off-White & Black Printed A-Line Kurta
title: Cotton Culture Printed A-Line Kurta
description: Embrace effortless elegance with this Cotton Culture off-white and black printed A-line kurta. Crafted from 100% breathable pure cotton, it features delicate geometric prints, a flattering calf-length silhouette, and 3/4 sleeves, making it perfect for everyday ethnic wear and office days.

name: Bacca Bucci Men's RFID Blocking Slim Leather Bifold Wallet
title: Bacca Bucci RFID Slim Leather Wallet
description: Keep your cards and cash safe with the Bacca Bucci RFID blocking slim leather wallet. The RFID-blocking layer protects your contactless cards from unauthorised scanning, while the bifold design keeps everything organised in a slim, pocket-friendly profile. A thoughtful gift for any occasion.

name: Bonjour Men's Formal Genuine Leather Belt with Pin Buckle
title: Bonjour Formal Leather Belt
description: A sharp belt completes any formal look, and this Bonjour genuine leather belt delivers. The classic pin buckle design in polished metal pairs seamlessly with formal trousers, chinos, or jeans. Made from premium leather, it's built to age gracefully and last for years.

name: Men's Lightweight EVA Clog Floaters with Quick-Dry Design
title: Men's Lightweight Clog Floaters
description: Lightweight, quick-drying, and incredibly comfortable — these clog floaters are your best bet for beach trips, poolside lounging, or a quick run to the store. Made from one-piece EVA foam, they are waterproof, easy to clean, and virtually weightless on your feet.

name: Regal Shoes Men's Leather Back-Strap Sandals
title: Regal Men's Leather Sandals
description: These Regal leather sandals are built for the man who values quality and comfort in equal measure. The genuine leather straps mould to the shape of your foot over time, while the back strap ensures a secure fit during long walks. Perfect for summer, beach outings, or everyday casual wear.

name: Men's Premium Leather Slip-On Loafers
title: Men's Leather Slip-On Loafers
description: Effortlessly stylish and supremely comfortable, these leather slip-on loafers are the modern man's essential. No laces, no fuss — just slip them on and head out. Their versatility is unmatched: pair them with chinos for a smart-casual look, or formal trousers for a boardroom-ready appearance.

name: Louis Philippe Leather Oxford Formal Shoes
title: Louis Philippe Oxford Formal Shoes
description: Command attention from the ground up with these Louis Philippe leather Oxford formal shoes. Crafted from genuine leather with a high-gloss polish finish, they embody sophistication and craftsmanship. The classic Oxford silhouette makes them the ultimate companion for business attire, suits, and formal occasions.

name: Relaxo Men's Ergonomic Casual Shoes with Arch Support
title: Relaxo Casual Shoes with Arch Support
description: Relaxo's casual shoes are engineered for all-day comfort without sacrificing style. The built-in arch support makes them ideal for those on their feet all day, while the lightweight design ensures zero fatigue. A great everyday shoe for work, errands, and leisure.

name: Men's Low-Top Fashion Sneakers with Cushioned Sole
title: Low-Top Fashion Sneakers
description: Step into effortless style with these low-top fashion sneakers. Whether you're headed to college, a mall, or a casual hangout, they pair with virtually any outfit — jeans, chinos, or shorts. The cushioned sole absorbs impact and keeps you comfortable on long walks.

name: Woodland Camel Slim Fit Stretch Cotton Chinos
title: Woodland Slim Fit Camel Chinos
description: Woodland's camel chinos are the perfect bridge between casual and formal. The warm camel tone is incredibly versatile — it pairs equally well with white shirts, navy polos, or earth-toned tees. The stretch cotton fabric ensures comfort whether you're at the office, on a date, or exploring the outdoors.

name: Fugazee Men's Slim Fit Flat-Front Formal Trousers
title: Fugazee Slim Fit Formal Trousers
description: These Fugazee slim fit trousers are the cornerstone of every well-dressed man's wardrobe. Crafted for a sleek, professional silhouette, they feature a flat-front design and clean-cut fabric that pairs beautifully with formal shirts, polo tees, or blazers. Office-ready and weekend-appropriate.

name: Freakins Men's Slim Tapered Light Wash Stretch Denim
title: Freakins Slim Tapered Stretch Denim
description: Rock the light-wash trend with these Freakins slim tapered stretch denims. The light blue wash gives a youthful, relaxed vibe perfect for weekends, while the stretch fabric ensures you're never restricted in movement. The tapered leg from knee to ankle gives a contemporary silhouette.

name: Dennison Men's Slim Fit Mid-Rise Dark Wash Jeans
title: Dennison Slim Fit Dark Wash Jeans
description: A wardrobe essential, these Dennison slim fit jeans in a versatile dark wash are built for everyday wear. The mid-rise waist and tapered leg create a clean, modern silhouette that works whether you're pairing it with a casual tee or a sharp formal shirt. Durable denim that keeps its shape.

name: Men's Slim Fit Single-Breasted Formal Blazer
title: Men's Slim Fit Formal Blazer
description: Command any room with this single-breasted slim fit blazer. The sharp tailoring and structured silhouette make it indispensable for business meetings, formal events, or a polished evening look. Wear it over a formal shirt for the boardroom or dress it down with a plain tee for a smart-casual vibe.

name: Cahoot Men's Casual Bomber Jacket with Ribbed Hem
title: Cahoot Casual Bomber Jacket
description: The Cahoot bomber jacket is your go-to for effortless cool. Whether you're heading out for a coffee run or a casual evening with friends, this jacket delivers on both style and comfort. The ribbed hem and cuffs give it that classic bomber silhouette, while the zip closure adds a clean, modern finish.

name: South Loom Traditional Cotton Vesti & Jubba Ethnic Set
title: South Loom Traditional Vesti Set
description: Embrace South Indian heritage with this beautifully crafted Vesti and Jubba set from South Loom. Made from soft, pure cotton with a traditional gold-zari border, it's the perfect attire for temple visits, poojas, weddings, or cultural celebrations. Comfortable, breathable, and authentically crafted.

name: CBazaar Grey Silk Embroidered Sequins Kurta Pyjama for Men
title: Grey Silk Embroidered Kurta Pyjama Set
description: Make a regal statement at weddings, festivals, or celebrations with this exquisite grey silk kurta pyjama set. The kurta is adorned with intricate embroidery and shimmering sequin work, offering a perfect blend of tradition and contemporary craftsmanship. Paired with a matching pyjama for a complete, elegant look.

name: Men's Slim Fit Fleece Joggers with Cuffed Hem
title: Slim Fit Fleece Joggers
description: Stay cosy and on-trend with these slim fit fleece joggers. The cuffed hem and tapered leg give a neat, modern silhouette that looks just as good on the streets as in the gym. An elasticated waist with a drawstring makes it easy to put on and take off without compromising on style.

name: AJIO Active Slim Fit Track Pants with Side Pockets
title: AJIO Active Track Pants
description: Power through your workout or lounge in style with these AJIO Active track pants. Engineered for performance and comfort, the lightweight fabric wicks moisture while the elastic waistband with drawstring ensures a secure, customisable fit. Side pockets keep your essentials close.

name: TIGC Men's Solid Polo T-Shirt with Ribbed Collar
title: TIGC Men's Polo T-Shirt
description: Elevate your smart-casual look with this solid polo T-shirt from TIGC. The classic polo collar instantly lifts any outfit from casual to smart. Crafted from premium pique fabric, it keeps you cool and comfortable all day — perfect for college, work-from-home, or a relaxed evening out.

name: Trip India Plain Round Neck Graphic T-Shirt
title: Trip India Plain T-Shirt
description: Keep it simple and stylish with this plain round-neck T-shirt from Trip India. Made from soft, skin-friendly cotton, it's the perfect everyday essential. Wear it solo for a minimal look or layer it under an open shirt — the versatility is unmatched.

name: Peter England Slim Fit Solid Formal Shirt
title: Peter England Formal Shirt
description: Look sharp and professional with this Peter England slim fit formal shirt. Designed for the modern working man, it features a crisp solid colour that pairs effortlessly with trousers, chinos, or a tailored suit. A trusted name in Indian formal wear for over three decades.

name: Campus Sutra Men's Comfort Opaque Checked Casual Shirt
title: Campus Sutra Checked Casual Shirt
description: Upgrade your casual wardrobe with this classic checked shirt from Campus Sutra. Crafted from soft, breathable fabric, it offers a relaxed fit perfect for weekend outings, brunches, or a laid-back day at the office. The rich check pattern adds a touch of style while keeping comfort front and centre.
